detailed_descriptions.en: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions is an arcade football game bringing a refreshing look to the football genre with the exhilarating action and over the top shots. ⚽ BUILD YOUR DREAM ELEVEN Create your own characters with new skills and abilities, and build your dream team to play offline and online! ⚽ 4 PLAYER VERSUS Decide who's the football legend amongst your friends with offline versus up to 4 players! ⚽ ONLINE Compete across several online modes to claim trophies and rewards. ⚽ 2 STORY MODES Experience the events from the anime or become a part of the world of Captain Tsubasa!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions is an arcade football game bringing a refreshing look to the football genre with the exhilarating action and over the top shots.

⚽ BUILD YOUR DREAM ELEVEN

Create your own characters with new skills and abilities, and build your dream team to play offline and online!

⚽ 4 PLAYER VERSUS

Decide who's the football legend amongst your friends with offline versus up to 4 players!

⚽ ONLINE

Compete across several online modes to claim trophies and rewards.

⚽ 2 STORY MODES

Experience the events from the anime or become a part of the world of Captain Tsubasa!
